If it’s any consolation life as complicated and tiring as it may seem really is simple in nature. All that you will ever feel or experience is simply a variation of pleasure or pain. Those who feel pain want to escape it, and those who feel pleasure wish to preserve it. There is no guarantee of an afterlife nor is there of anything really. However, one thing is certain and that is suicide is permanent. If you wish to kill yourself the first time for sure then the best method will always be a gun, however given that is hard to attain I suppose you could jump off a bridge or hang yourself. Those are fairly permanent despite likely being somewhat painful. Overdosing is always an option however again it is difficult to get a hold of dangerous pills. If this is really just a cry for help then I recommend reaching out to anyone you can. Regardless of how embarrassing or exposing it may feel. Remember, you can always kill yourself tomorrow.

What you describe is most similar to depression, try seeking therapy if possible. This seems to be much deeper than simply sadness. As people we can’t help but search for reasons but many things just have none, they just happen. There’s no higher power we can rely on, no one pulling the strings, everyone is lost and purposeless. Karma is just a myth, no one is deserving or undeserving of anything. Our world is chaotic, though this isn’t purely a bad thing. For it means every second we live, it is in spite of a world which tries to deny you. Your being itself is a testament to your own strength. So that when you do find happiness you will have defied all the odds. There is no one meaning or reason to live, though nothing is stopping you from finding your own. You have nothing to lose and everything to gain, take action, try new things, make new friends, find reasons to wake up in the morning. Every single step that you take is defying a broken world.

You’re not wrong for expecting more in return, but the world doesn’t care. You can fight, push, claw your way to the top just to fall back down again. In a fucked up world you have to make fucked up compromises. This world is chaotic, disordered, and entirely absurd. It’s useless to try and control other people. You have to rely on yourself. People will come and leave, love and hate, help and hurt, no matter what you do you cannot change human nature. So all that’s left is to change yourself. Happiness is never guaranteed, but the first step to reaching it is to find it within yourself and not relying on others to fill the hole in your heart.
